Once she approves, the draft will cover this, taken from #inc-vtg-hartford:
- Outage: gate kiosks went offline on 2026-08-03 around 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Recovery: kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in). Both lanes were confirmed working as of 11:07 AM.
- Status page: Mateo's login was denied on the status page. That is tracked in ticket INC-4821, which has the screenshot.

Two things to check before you send it: the incident room doesn't say when the status-page problem was resolved, so you may want to add that. And the mail address I'll use is mateoquiroga@vantorre-group.example, from the directory.
